title: Yoda
franchise: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
description: Yoda, the legendary Jedi Master, had exiled himself to the swamp world of Dagobah through the Empire's reign. There, he waited and watched until it was time to train young Luke Skywalker as a Jedi so that they might end the times of darkness that had taken over the galaxy, but he found Luke to be impatient and angry, like his father. Reluctantly, his training he began.
